I think it is very possible to utilize today's technology with a new pipeline and protect the environment. We know that a pipeline in this situation is the safest way to transport the product, certainly safer than rail or highway. And I think that seeing what the possibilities are, it's time to get this done that I think the president has had enough time to study it. You know, when you talk about overall energy transportation, ethanol is important, and here we see rail capacity taken up with oil, and that I think puts grains and processed grains into ethanol at a competitive disadvantage because the transportation costs have been driven up. And so, now this is quite a problem that we have on our hands, but we need good policies in place infrastructure-wise I mean, here we are now considered the Saudi Arabia of natural gas. And if we don't have the right infrastructure and the right transportation for that, it won't matter. You know, we won't benefit from this tremendous natural resource like we could if we had some good policies in place for getting these products to market.
